parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Yes / No quiz
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Answer every question: Yes, No or ?. Press ? if you do not know. You lose 1 mark for each wrong answer.

items.q: We can’t walk ____ moving our legs.
Rob is sitting ____ your left-hand side.
We use “into” for a thing that moves from one place to ____ .
This is your pen; it’s yours. That is my pen; it’s ____ .
How ____ are your English lessons? Do they last fifty minutes?
Josef is putting the food into the ____ .
I have ____ friends, but I have ____ friends than Harry!

parts.title: Part 4 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word.

items.text: The Spanish word “pantalones” mean “trousers” in English.
I’m not teaching you English; I’m learn English from you.
My eyes are different colours. One eye is blue, and the another eye is grey.
I’m not enough tall to touch the ceiling.
I have less friends than Harry.
The small boy generally goes in bed before his sister.

parts.text: I’m telling you my name. Half of the people in this town are men. We stand up after the lesson. The French are different from the Russians. Mrs Brown’s husband is standing in front of the house. I’m learning English from you. There are few people in a small village. There are twelve months in a year. We wear a watch on our wrist. The red book is small and the blue one is large. Today is Thursday; the day after tomorrow will be Saturday. The small boy goes to bed before his sister. I want to live for a hundred years. Rob likes playing the piano.

teacher.15: Do we drink coffee from a glass?
